info.name: Fern Ask Fern API
info.description: Fern's hosted public REST API for the AI-powered 'Ask Fern' documentation search. Index a documentation website, poll indexing status, and query indexed content for grounded answers. Base URL: https://fai.buildwithfern.com. Authenticated with a Bearer token generated by the `fern token` CLI command; available on Team and Enterprise plans. The website index/status endpoints are grounded in Fern's published reference; the /ask query endpoint shape is modeled and should be reconciled against the live reference. Fern's SDK generation and docs generation run through the open-source `fern` CLI, not this API.

request.description: Start an indexing job that crawls and indexes a documentation website. Returns a job_id. (Modeled endpoint - reconcile against the live reference.)

query.description: The job ID returned from the index endpoint.

request.description: Return the status of a website indexing job, including pages_indexed and pages_failed. (Confirmed endpoint.)
Submit a natural-language question and receive an AI-generated answer grounded in the indexed documentation. (Modeled endpoint shape - reconcile against the live reference.)
